title: Fixed Endless Disc Loop and Open Riser Pump Display
description: One wholly newly authored complete free-standing dry rope-and-disc-lift-inspired inspection display. One genuinely continuous closed constant-section cord loop passes around two entire open three-spoke pulleys on separate full through axles. Eight complete small annular discs are fixed to the two straight cord runs, four on each side, rather than occupying a common rigid spindle. The left run passes through the real inner space of one entire full-height open-front half-round riser shell, whose two full longitudinal inspection lips and both finite end rims are supplied. The shell sits between and clear of both pulley rims on two full rear brackets and a separate full-length rear mounting rail. Two whole upright posts, two complete cross rails and two broad grounded soles support the shafts, open pulleys, loop, casing, crank arm and complete forward hand grip. Unlike the common-spindle contactor, there is no horizontal basin, large repeated radial disc stack or shared rigid shaft through all discs. Unlike the stationary open U tube and three-roller pump, the single full cord itself forms an endless tall loop, small discs travel conceptually with it, and the straight open riser is separate from the upper and lower pulley axles; there is no closed semicircular hose head or radial three-roller carrier. All shape coordinates and full material boundaries newly authored together; no old tube, frame, disc, pulley or basin mesh imported, extracted or transformed. Thirty-three editable complete closed material meshes, four opaque constant untextured PBR roles, metre-style native Z up and horizontal bounds-centred ground datum, one whole display model zero scenes. Broad rope-pump category only: original artistic proportions, not a replica of any public-domain standard or installed well pump. Turning arcs are deliberately free of discs in this fixed display pose, and small rooted cord-to-rim overlaps are static visual joins, not solved rolling or friction contacts. The deliberately open-front casing is an entire authored inspection shell, not a sealed rising main; there is no well, immersed guide box, discharge spout, water circuit or operating installation. No water lifting, hydraulic continuity, pumping output, water quality, drinking-water suitability, piston sealing, rope tension, disc transport path, pulley rotation, friction, drive operation, loading, stability, wear, manufacture, installation, maintenance or machinery/public-health safety capability made or verified. No fluid, animation, rigging or interaction.
